annotations.target_phrase: Welcome to the Rue Jules Verne
annotations.annotation_text: The main circumferential boulevard of Freeside, named after science fiction pioneer Jules Verne, built as an artificial terrestrial paradise for Earth's ultra-wealthy elite.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 132.

annotations.target_phrase: Lado-Acheson system whose two-millimeter armature ran the length of the spindle
annotations.annotation_text: The artificial sunlight and projection apparatus of Freeside: simulating Mediterranean skies (Cannes) along the curved inner hull of the rotating spindle, an engineered simulacrum of terrestrial nature.
sources: Gibson, William. Neuromancer. Ace Books, 1984, p. 132.
